member.name: M:Xmip.Cli.Test.UsageTest.CommandLine
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^\s*(?<command>xmip(?: \S+)*)(?<gap>\s{2,}(?=\S))?
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ "command" capture group.
○ Match the string "xmip".
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match ' '.
○ Match any character other than a whitespace character greedily at least once.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ "gap" capture group.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically at least twice.
○ Zero-width positive lookahead.
○ Match any character other than a whitespace character.

member.name: T:Xmip.Surface.Test.TestEndpoint
member.summary: A local endpoint's name no other test or run uses: the one place a .NET test takes one from. One file, compiled into every .NET test project that names an endpoint (each links it), so there is one rule.
member.remarks: On Linux and macOS the runtime places the endpoint called a name at <folder><name>/<name>.sock, the name twice, and refuses a socket's path longer than a Unix domain socket holds: 107 bytes on Linux, 103 on macOS (ADR-0014, amendment 2026-11-15).
